Wanting something is not the same as doing the work.

Kevin Trudeau gives a blunt example. Someone says they want to get in shape, then skips the gym for the game, the popcorn and the pizza.

He calls that lip service. Wanting something and doing what it takes are two different things.

Kevin says successful people are too busy doing what everyone else is still only talking about.

What is one thing you keep talking about but have not started?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

You may know it. But you are not applying it.

Kevin Trudeau describes people who visit his house, go through his training and say they know it all. They have even passed the tests.

But he can see and hear that they are not using what they learned. That is the problem.

His rule is simple: to know and not to do is not to know. Knowledge only counts when you act on it.

What is one thing you know you should do but have not done?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

One hour a day, door locked, phone off: a habit of leaders.

Kevin Trudeau says leaders are always readers. He points to Elon Musk, who has said that one of the most important things he does is lock the door and shut off the phone.

No interruptions. No distractions. For one hour, five days a week, he learns something new, mostly by reading.

Kevin says consistency and persistency of effort is the key. You have to do the right things long enough.

When did you last give yourself one hour with no phone?
